market_analysis.market_type_reason: This market is B2B because empty capsules are purchased exclusively by pharmaceutical companies, nutraceutical brands, and contract manufacturers to be filled with their own medical or dietary formulations.
market_analysis.market_definition: The Global Empty Capsules Market covers empty (unfilled) capsule shells that pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, nutraceutical, cosmetic companies and clinical research organizations fill with their own formulations: gelatin capsules (porcine, bovine and marine / fish gelatin) and non-gelatin capsules (plant-based HPMC and pullulan, carrageenan, polyvinyl alcohol and others), hard and soft shells, sizes 000 to 5, with immediate-, delayed-, sustained- and targeted-release functionality, for oral release, specialized delivery, pre-clinical and clinical use, sold online and offline.
market_analysis.core_scope: A core player manufactures empty capsule shells under its own name and sells them to companies that fill them: hard gelatin, HPMC, pullulan or other non-gelatin capsules, including enteric, delayed- or sustained-release and clinical-trial capsules.
adjacent_segments: Capsule-filling, banding and capsule-manufacturing machinery makers
Gelatin, HPMC, pullulan and other raw-material suppliers to capsule makers
Contract manufacturers (CDMOs) and softgel makers that fill capsules for clients rather than sell empty shells
Finished capsule supplement or drug brands
Distributors and traders of other companies' empty capsules

market_participants.definition: Companies that produce the physical empty capsule shells from raw polymers and sell them as finished components.
market_participants.why_relevant: They control the product quality, regulatory compliance, and material innovation (e.g., enteric coatings, vegetarian alternatives) that buyers compare directly.

market_analysis.primary_reason: Manufacturer is the correct player type because the market is defined by a physical component that companies produce under their own names, and buyers compare these direct producers based on material science, quality standards, and manufacturing scale.
